content: UX-portfolio-specific sources converge on: recruiters skim in minutes not hours; case studies must name the problem in the first paragraph or lose the reader in the first 30 seconds; effective structure leads with a compact overview (role, goal, outcome/metrics) before any process detail; heavy skimmability via headings/bullets; reviewers use the writeup to judge process-thinking and decision rationale, not just the polished output.
